messages.en:
{07 00 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}! Can you
believe it? The {ff 00 00 03}Fireworks
Show{ff 00 00 00} is finally here!
{07 0d 00}I am SO psyched! I've been
looking forward to this
all year, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}! Kas sa suudad
uskuda? {ff 00 00 03}Ilutulestikushow{ff 00 00 00}
on lõpuks käes!
{07 0d 00}Ma olen NII elevil! Ma olen
seda terve aasta
oodanud, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Fireworks are like bright,
sparkling flowers that
blossom for only a second.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Ilutulestik on nagu eredad,
sätendavad lilled, mis
õitsevad vaid sekundi.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}This is when the fireworks
are at their peak! Isn't it
fabulous, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 13 00}That last one looked like
a wreath made of rose
blossoms, {01 00 00 03 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}See on hetk, kui ilutulestik
on tipus! Kas pole
vapustav, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 13 00}See viimane nägi välja nagu
pärg roosiõitest,
{01 00 00 03 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Watching fireworks makes
all my cares and worries go
away, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Ilutulestiku vaatamine paneb
kõik mu mured kaduma,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}It looks like the fireworks
are coming to an end. I
wish they lasted longer.
{07 16 00}I try to hold on to the
memory, but it fades so
quickly, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Paistab, et ilutulestik
hakkab lõppema. Soovin,
et see kestaks kauem.
{07 16 00}Ma üritan mälestust hoida,
aga see kaob nii
kiiresti, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Here it is! The grand
finale! One final burst
before the end!
{07 14 00}It's like watching a field
of flowers blossom and fade
in an instant, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Siin see on! Suur
finaal! Üks viimane pauk
enne lõppu!
{07 14 00}See on nagu vaadata, kuidas
lilleväli õitseb ja kaob
hetkega, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}The first fireworks of the
year! They're so beautiful!

{07 14 00}They almost look more
fabulous than last year's.

{07 0d 00}Did you see that last
one? Incredible! Awesome!
Unbelievable, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Aasta esimene ilutulestik!
Nad on nii ilusad!

{07 14 00}Nad näevad peaaegu
vapustavamad kui mullu.

{07 0d 00}Kas sa nägid seda viimast?
Uskumatu! Vinge!
Uskumatu, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}You won't have to wait until
next year for more
fireworks, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
There'll be more this
month! {07 0d 00}Fweeeeeeee{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 03 00}BOOM!{01 01 00} {07 14 00}I
love fireworks so much!{01 00 00 0f 00}
{07 0a 00}I could watch them forever!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Sa ei pea järgmise aastani
ootama, et veel tulevärki
näha, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
Sel kuul tuleb veel!
{07 0d 00}Fviiiiiii{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{07 03 00}PAUH!{01 01 00} {07 14 00}Ma
armastan ilutulestikku!{01 00 00 0f 00}
{07 0a 00}Võiksin vaadata igavesti!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Fireworks bring out the kid
in all of us, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

{07 0e 00}Maybe it's because they're
so beautiful. {01 00 00 0f 00}{07 14 00}Or maybe it's
just because they explode.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Ilutulestik toob meis kõigis
lapse välja, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

{07 0e 00}Ehk sellepärast, et nad on
nii ilusad. {01 00 00 0f 00}{07 14 00}Või ehk lihtsalt
sest nad plahvatavad.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}No matter how long I stand
here and stare at the sky,
fireworks NEVER get boring!
{07 06 00}Look! Look! {01 00 00 14 00}I hope you
didn't miss that really big
one, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Ükskõik kui kaua ma siin
seisan ja taevast vahin,
ilutulestik EI tüüta mind!
{07 06 00}Vaata! Vaata! {01 00 00 14 00}Loodan, et sa
ei jäänud sellest suurest
ilma, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}I can't believe Saturday
will be the last {ff 00 00 03}Fireworks
Show{ff 00 00 00} of the year!
{07 06 00}You'd better believe I'm
going to party the night
away before they're gone!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Ma ei suuda uskuda, et
laupäev on aasta viimane
{ff 00 00 03}ilutulestikushow{ff 00 00 00}!
{07 06 00}Võid kindel olla, et ma
pidutsen öö läbi, enne
kui nad kaovad!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}This is the last {ff 00 00 03}Fireworks
Show{ff 00 00 00} for the year. It went
by so quickly{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
I'm never going to forget
this year's festival,
though, {04 1f 00}.
{07 14 00}That's because I got to
spend it with you,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}See on aasta viimane
{ff 00 00 03}ilutulestikushow{ff 00 00 00}. See möödus
nii kiiresti{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
Ma ei unusta selle aasta
festivali kunagi,
{04 1f 00}.
{07 14 00}Sest ma sain seda veeta
koos sinuga,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 06 00}Eeek!{01 00 00 05 00} Wow!{01 00 00 05 00} Oh, that was
amazing, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 00 00}You should spend more
time watching the
fireworks, {04 1f 00}.
{07 0d 00}If you spend your time
talking instead of watching,
you're missing half the fun!
messages.et:
{07 06 00}Iik!{01 00 00 05 00} Vau!{01 00 00 05 00} Oh, see oli
hämmastav, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 00 00}Sa peaksid rohkem aega
veetma ilutulestikku
vaadates, {04 1f 00}.
{07 0d 00}Kui sa veedad aega rääkides
selle asemel, et vaadata,
jääd sa poolest lõbust ilma!
